notes.it: Odontoiatria e Protesi Dentaria (Roma): sei coorti, calendari disponibili dal primo al quinto anno, 36 syllabus, Materiali e appelli. Soglie distinte per didattica frontale (67%) e tirocinio clinico (90%).
notes.en: Dentistry and Dental Prosthetics (Rome): six cohorts, timetables for years one to five, 36 syllabi, Materials and exams. Separate attendance thresholds for classroom teaching (67%) and clinical placements (90%).
